name: web-animator-portfolio-neon-doodle-dark-page
title: Animator portfolio on black with neon lime, violet blobs and sketchy cartoon character
whatItIs: A tall dark portfolio page: hero with brush-lettered 'Dikshant', lime underline and pills, a waving cartoon character with a speech bubble, blobs of violet and blue, a showreel card, featured project tiles in bright illustrated colours, a skills row of software icons, an about card with a lime portrait and a contact footer with a sticker character. Hand-drawn doodles sit throughout.
whatItMeans: Energetic, youthful and fun; illustration and doodles give an animator's personality.
techniques: Set the name in brush-marker lettering with a highlighter underline.
Use neon lime and violet on near-black for maximum pop.
Add small doodle marks between sections.
Use rounded dark cards to hold different content types.
Let an illustrated character interact with the hero text.

vocabulary.definition: Letters that look painted with a marker or brush.
A thick coloured stroke under text.
Small hand-drawn marks placed around a layout.
A page of stacked dark rounded panels.
